clause0_repair.container: evidence/units/S75-T41/attempt-4.json, carried forward by this attempt without redoing or weakening it
clause0_repair.was: FixtureCases.test_fixture_covers_the_whole_class asserted that the fixture's case ids contained REQUIRED_CASES, a tuple the test file itself declared. Nothing derived coverage from the payload, the catalogue or the compiler, so the test's own declaration was the oracle. With all nine cases keeping their ids and every inject emptied to {}, the check still passed.
clause0_repair.now: It asserts the property on the injected BYTES. Each case's inject is deep-merged onto a real envelope, then _witnessed over _walk_text / _walk_keys / _forms_in / is_protected re-derives which of the ten clause-0 dimensions are actually present: case and punctuation variants from the raw spellings against the catalogue's display names, key-position / list-value / instruction-value / nested-position from the walker's paths, negative-key / negative-list-value / negative-instruction from the field name plus a negation cue, approved-content from the protected-path predicate. Every REQUIRED_DIMENSIONS entry must be witnessed and each id naming a dimension the bytes do not show is a failure. The id is a claim the bytes must confirm, never the oracle.
